name: asciinema agg
notes: 2026-11-01: Renders asciicast recordings to GIF via gifski, deterministically from event timestamps.
2026-11-01: Triage: assess. Report rates it worth cataloguing.
2026-11-24: Toolkit guide written from the agg-asciicast-gif evidence; absolute GIF size depends on the resolved font, so the guide says to pin fonts.

evidence.result: Hand-written asciicast v2 with four output events rendered at --font-size 16 and 32, 40x6 cells: 403x157 and 806x314 px (2.00x), 5 GIF frames at 0/0.5/1/2/3 s, 5.00 s duration, rerun byte-identical; contact sheet shows the prompt, echo, output and ok lines in order.
evidence.scope: Hand-written asciicast v2 (4 events) to GIF on macOS arm64, system JetBrains Mono: 403x157 px at 16 px, 5 frames, 5.00 s, rerun byte-identical; absolute size is font-dependent

summary: Turns asciicast event recordings into timestamped GIFs, with frame selection, themes and font rendering. The CLI preserves recording timing and supports excerpt or marker selection.
use_when: Render asciicast recordings as GIF with event timing
Select time ranges or markers from terminal recordings
avoid_when: For arbitrary GIF assembly from images, use FFmpeg
For GIF size optimization, use gifsicle

assessment.rationale: Official project sources identify 1.9.0 as the latest available version/release (2026-05-29); maintenance assessed from release evidence. Documentation assessment only; no local installation or fixture evidence.
